body_markdown:
*The integration automates loan calculations, compliance validation, and disclosures within MANTL Loan Origination, helping financial institutions improve efficiency, accelerate decisions, and increase lending accuracy*


**PLANO, Texas — Oct.** **21, 2026 —** Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) (“Alkami”), a[digital sales and service platform provider](https://www.alkami.com/) for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced a new integration between[MANTL](https://www.alkami.com/mantl-onboarding-account-opening/) and[Carleton, Inc](https://www.carletoninc.com/) (Carleton) that brings automated loan calculations, amortization, and compliance validation directly into[MANTL Loan Origination](https://www.mantl.com/loan-origination/) . The integration helps financial institutions automate complex lending processes, reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and deliver faster, more accurate lending decisions.


Through[CarletonCalcs® OriginationPlus](https://www.carletoninc.com/solutions/carletoncalcs/originationplus/) , MANTL automates loan calculations, contract disclosures, amortization schedules, and compliance validation within a single lending workflow. By eliminating manual calculations and reducing data movement between systems, the integration helps lending teams originate loans more efficiently, validate disclosures with greater confidence, and deliver a faster borrower experience across physical and digital banking channels.


“Modern lending depends on automation,” said Benjamin Conant, chief product officer at Alkami. “Every manual step adds complexity for lenders and slows the experience for borrowers. MANTL Loan Origination is designed to automate as much of the lending workflow as possible so financial institutions can focus on serving borrowers, not managing processes. As more financial institutions modernize lending, we’re continuing to expand the ecosystem around MANTL Loan Origination with partners to reduce operational friction and help institutions deliver better lending experiences from application through funding.”


CarletonCalcs® OriginationPlus combines loan calculations and compliance validation to support compliant direct loan origination. The integration provides contract disclosure values, fees, taxes, insurance premiums, and other loan-specific charges while ensuring transactions adhere to federal and state-specific requirements and institutional rules. Where configured, the platform can automatically adjust loan terms to help keep transactions within defined compliance parameters, reducing manual intervention while giving lenders greater confidence throughout the origination process.


“The challenge in lending today is keeping pace with the complex and ever-changing regulatory requirements that govern those calculations,” said Matt Ruszkowski, president and chief operating officer at Carleton. “For decades, Carleton has helped financial institutions navigate that complexity. Our integration with MANTL brings that expertise directly into the lending workflow, enabling financial institutions to originate loans faster while maintaining confidence in the accuracy and compliance of every transaction.”


To learn how MANTL can help your financial institution grow its lending portfolio, visit[here](https://www.mantl.com/request-a-demo/) .

**About Alkami**


[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/press-room) provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S.[banks](https://www.alkami.com/banks/) and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.


**About Carleton, Inc.**


[Carleton](https://www.carletoninc.com/) provides integrated financial solutions that support the full lending lifecycle, delivering accurate and compliant loan origination calculations, automated document generation and delivery, and expert audit and compliance services nationwide. For more than 55 years, Carleton has been trusted by lenders, financial institutions, and technology providers to navigate complex federal and state regulations while reducing risk and improving operational efficiency. By unifying calculation accuracy, regulatory compliance, and document workflows into a foundational solution, Carleton elevates its partners’ platforms, helping them accelerate funding, maintain confidence in compliance, and focus on growing their business.
